attributes.action: Require the NHS to include the womb in the organ donor list
attributes.additional_details: Womb transplantation is now a reality in the UK, giving women born without a womb, including those with MRKH, and some women who have lost their womb, the possibility of carrying a pregnancy. However, womb donation is not currently covered by the NHS Organ Donor Register. Families must instead be approached for separate consent. We are asking for people to be given the choice to record their wish to donate their womb after death, alongside their other organs and have womb transplants funded by the NHS.
attributes.background: Require the NHS to include wombs (uteruses) in the organ donation system, allowing people to donate their wombs for transplantation and enabling eligible patients to receive womb transplants.
